description: Header file defining the InputFileManager class responsible for managing loading and parsing files, including asynchronous and synchronous operations, memory management, and thread safety within a build system context.

classes.name: InputFileManager
classes.description: Manages loading, parsing, and memory management of input files in a thread-safe manner, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: InputFileManager::InputFileData
classes.description: Internal structure holding data related to a loaded input file, including file content, tokens, parse tree, and load status.

methods.name: AsyncLoadFile
methods.description: Loads a file asynchronously, invoking a callback upon completion or error.

methods.name: SyncLoadFile
methods.description: Loads and parses a file synchronously, returning the parse tree root or NULL on error.

methods.name: AddDynamicInput
methods.description: Registers a dynamic input file, managing its memory and parse data.

methods.name: GetInputFileCount
methods.description: Returns the number of input files managed.

methods.name: AddAllPhysicalInputFileNamesToVectorSetSorter
methods.description: Adds all physical input file paths to a sorter for efficient merging and sorting.

methods.name: set_load_file_callback
methods.description: Sets a custom callback for loading files, primarily for testing.
